GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok well back Settled Down last 6 Lengths 900m Checked 800m last 5 Lengths home turn last Middle Of Track Straight ran on final 150 # back/ran on/ready
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly.  Passing the 900m was checked after improving between runners and tightened for room shortly after. Approaching the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to improve until near the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 7 lengths. well back turn. battled away # pulled up lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped rounding home turn. When questioned, rdr stated his mount settled at the rear of the field, which is typical, and travelled comfortably in the early and middle stages, however when asked to sprint on straightening it failed to show its normal turn of foot and only ground its way to the line. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame in the off foreleg (1/5). Tnr was told a vet clearance is required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ms 2len Settled Down last fence 10len held up 500m Hooked Out 200m made good ground late # good run from back

Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (6L from lead). Raced keenly & improved 2 Lengths midrace until improving 3 Wide from 500m & pushed to quicken Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & raced away in last 200m to win easily. # Bolted in!
Bit Slow Out 1 length settled near last 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well making good ground # back/ran on well
(ex Connie Greig) Slow Out 3l rear 9l home turn 8l angled Middle Of Track Straightening Up finished on well out wide, start against, nice return # badstart/didwell
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Missed the start (3L). Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: 2 Lengths slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to chase 3 Wide @ 500m. Struggling Seven Wide (8L from lead) on home turn. Not ridden out in straight. Rider - saddle slipped fwd. # Saddle slipped
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Missed the start (2L). Apprentice reported that her saddle had slipped forward near the 600m and, as a result, she was placed at a disadvantage for the remainder of the race. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 4l off all clear, worked home ok making steady ground without threatening # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was hampered.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced keenly @ rear on inside (7L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & tracking up Four Wide @ 600m. Pushed out Five Wide @ 450m & pushed along Seven Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 9W @ 300m & ran on well near outside rail from 200m. Just missed. # Ran on well/missed.

Debut for stable. Slow away. Niggled early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & ground home @ one pace in last 200m. # One-paced.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider stated that after being hampered at the start, he settled towards the rear of the field. He added that from the 600m to near the 400m, he was held up and unable to improve whereby his mount finished the race off satisfactorily. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities
Slow to begin. Passing the 600m became held up on heels and was unable to improve until shortly after straightening.
